subject: Firefox
author: nismo_TK
body:
I use firefox, it's fast reliable/safe and has some really good add ons. a few u should try are cooliris (a 3d pic and video serch engine), flagfox (shows where the server for the site u are currently on is i.e i can see this site is hosted in denmark), and for those who do web design (like myself) firebug is a really good tool for reading a websites html code. Opera is also good but imo not as good as firefox. Im yet to try google chrome so if someone has a view on that i'd like to hear it. As for IE it's a bit slow and doesnt have the safety or add ons that firefox has but is easy to use and integrates well with windows live.

change is inevitable... except from a vending machine.

subject: IE, FireFox, Opera
author: Xandu
body:
Personally I prefer IE7 but lots of my friends use FireFox. As a secondary browser I use Opera. Opera is known for being fast and it had tabs years before IE. Opera also has a brilliant download manager. The only problem I find with using other browsers than IE is that lots of sites still requires IE to work properly.

-- The Creator --

subject: MOZILLA FIREFOX: The Best
author: Burnout_Legend
body: Yeah, I prefer Firefox3 best. I never had problems with it. Plus, it has new and special features. You can download safe add-ons like applications and themes. It has a download manager and 1-click bookmarking. Check it out and download it. You'll see the difference. Hope I helped.
